newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-MEDVEDEV EYES THIRD GERMAN TITLE.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-MEDVEDEV EYES THIRD GERMAN TITLE.

text.p: Andrei Medvedev of the Ukraine moved to within one match of his third German Open title in four years when he upset second seed Yevgeny Kafelnikov in straight sets on Saturday.
Mevedev collected his third seeded scalp of the tournament when he brushed past his Russian opponent 6-3 6-1.
The world number 38 said he was now playing to the same standard as three years ago when, as a 19-year-old, he rose to number four in the world.
"I like it here in Hamburg", he added.
Medvedev served strongly, approached the net confidently and unleashed a string of potent passing shots on the rare occasions Kafelnikov came to the net.
His victory followed successes over 12th seed Sergei Bruguera and third seed Richard Krajicek.
Unseeded German Tommy Haas will meet 10th seed Felix Mantilla of Spain in the other semifinal later on Saturday.
